title: Today: Pokémon Special Event Buenos Aires and four One Piece regionals (Bristol, São Paulo, Niagara Falls, Knoxville)
detail: Results should appear on Limitless within a day or two. The 7 Nov Porto and Sydney One Piece regional winners are still not on Limitless (its list still ends 26 Jul), so they remain unconfirmed.

title: OP-18 (The Dominance of God): Japanese release date reported as 22 Nov, not 21 Nov
detail: A retailer blog quoting an official X post from 22 Sep gives 11/22 for Japan; yesterday's note said 21 Nov (EN) and 21 Nov (JP). Calendar weekday doesn't match either, so treat the exact JP date as unconfirmed until Bandai's product page confirms it. Cards are still being revealed one by one. French date still unconfirmed.

title: League Battle Deck Mega Greninja ex slated for 11 Nov retail release
detail: Date comes from a trade-news summary (ICv2), not an official page, so check shelves before counting on it.

title: Price check: still no 20% moves, drifts of 4–6%
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket 7-day vs 30-day averages: Mew ex 152 €82.27 vs €87.75 (−6%); Gengar ex 154 €62.47 vs €66.64 (−6%); Pikachu ex 150 €50.23 vs €53.28 (−6%); Jirachi ex €31.27 vs €32.75 (−5%); Morpeko ex 117 €49.26 vs €51.66 (−5%); Mega Darkrai ex 116 €171.39 vs €177.82 (−4%).

title: Réunion: Miyata Kard Market Delta Reign second wave expected 17 Nov
detail: Page lists the 17/11 'second wave' on pre-order items (Bundle 6 boosters, Tripack, Elite Trainer Box, 36-booster display); the Elite Trainer Box, Tripack and display show 'Épuisé' (sold out) on the page. The page's own stock labels conflict, so check before travelling.
